facts.fact_text: The applicant acted as an authorised election assistant (վստահված անձ) for the main opposition candidate in the 2003 Armenian presidential election.
Following the first and second rounds of the 2003 Armenian presidential election, a series of protest rallies were organised in Yerevan by the opposition parties.
According to the materials of the case, the applicant attended one of the opposition protest rallies in Yerevan on 23 February 2003.
The charge of minor hooliganism against the applicant was on the ground that he had participated in the unauthorised demonstration of 23 February 2003 and had violated public order.
Judge H. found that on 23 February 2003 on Mashtots Avenue in Yerevan the applicant participated together with a group of people in an unauthorised demonstration and march, and violated public order.
On 26 February 2003 at 8 a.m. the applicant was visited at home by two police officers from the Shengavit District Police Department (ՀՀ ոստիկանության Շենգավիթի բաժին).
The applicant was taken to the Shengavit District Police Department police station on 26 February 2003.
At the Shengavit District Police Department police station an administrative case was initiated against the applicant.
The applicant was charged under Article 172 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – the Code of Administrative Offences) with minor hooliganism.
Judge H. found the applicant guilty as charged under Article 172 of the Code of Administrative Offences with minor hooliganism.
Judge H. sentenced the applicant to ten days of administrative detention.
The applicant was taken to a detention facility to serve his ten-day sentence of administrative detention.
The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal ordered the applicant's release from detention.
On the evening of 1 March 2003 the applicant was released from detention.
The applicant was charged under Article 172 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – the Code of Administrative Offences) with minor hooliganism.
The charge of minor hooliganism against the applicant was on the ground that he had participated in the unauthorised demonstration of 23 February 2003 and had violated public order.
Judge H. found that on 23 February 2003 on Mashtots Avenue in Yerevan the applicant participated together with a group of people in an unauthorised demonstration and march, and violated public order.
The decision of Judge H. of 26 February 2003 stated that it could be protested against by the prosecutor under Article 289 of the Code of Administrative Offences.
On 1 March 2003 the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal reviewed the applicant's conviction.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found, having reviewed the applicant's appeal and the materials concerning the administrative offence, that the penalty imposed on the applicant must be changed.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal changed the applicant's penalty from ten days of administrative detention to an administrative fine of 2,000 Armenian drams (AMD), which was approximately 3 euros (EUR) at the material time.

By a letter of 16 April 2003 the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal informed the applicant that his application of 26 March 2003 could not be examined, since the applicant had missed the prescribed 10-day time-limit for appeal.

The applicant alleged that only upon the visit of the officer of the Department for the Enforcement of Judicial Acts did he become aware of the existence of the decision of the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal of 1 March 2003.
